obStep1Title.message: Copy any page as clean Markdown

obStep1Body.message: Click the MarkGrab icon in your toolbar and the readable page lands on your clipboard as GitHub-flavored Markdown. Headings, lists, code blocks, tables and links all survive the trip.

obHow2.message: Click the MarkGrab icon in the toolbar
